claim: Let p be an odd prime and let \(\kappa_1,\ldots,\kappa_r\in H^1_{\mathrm{et}}(U,\mu_p)\) be independent coordinate Kummer classes. For an integer exponent matrix \(A\in\mathbb Z^{s\times r}\), the classes \(\alpha_i=\sum_j a_{ij}\kappa_j\) arising from Tate parameters \(q_i=p^p\prod_j T_j^{a_{ij}}\) all vanish after a finite étale monomial cover with exponent matrix \(M\) exactly when \(\bar A\bar M=0\); the least possible cover degree is \(p^{\operatorname{rank}_{\mathbb F_p}(\bar A)}\).
integrity: The proof is symbolic and self-contained under the stated assumptions; no numerical or external certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact minimum degree is proved only among finite étale monomial covers, not arbitrary finite étale covers.
The coordinate Kummer classes must be linearly independent, and the Tate parameters must be topologically nilpotent on the chosen domain.
The proof uses standard Kummer functoriality and Smith normal form; broader novelty beyond the stated optimization is not claimed.
title: Minimal monomial-cover degree for simultaneous Tate Kummer extensions
